#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MAXN = 105;
ll sum[MAXN];
ll pw[MAXN];
bool OK = false;

void process(ll cur, ll target, int pos) {
    if (cur == target) {
        OK = true;
        return;
    }
    ll remaining = sum[pos + 1];
    ll next = pw[pos];
    if (cur - remaining > target) {
        // do nothing
    } else if (cur + remaining < target) {
        // do nothing
    } else {
        if (cur + sum[pos] < target) {
            process(cur + next, target, pos - 1);
        } else if (cur - sum[pos] > target) {
            process(cur - next, target, pos - 1);
        } else {
            process(cur, target, pos - 1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ll w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    ll p = 1;
    int mx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        sum[i + 1] = p + sum[i];
        pw[i] = p;
        p *= w;
        if (p > (1LL << 40)) {
            mx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    process(0, m, mx);
    cout << (OK ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
